items.title: Australians caught between homelessness and the law

items.title: Authorities renew safety warning as Neil the seal destroys barrier
items.description: Neil the seal has become one of Tasmania’s biggest celebrities, with social media videos showing him knocking over bollards and leaning on cars. But wildlife experts are concerned his popularity could put him and the public at risk. Some large animals have been euthanised overseas due to public safety concerns, but Tasmanian authorities say that option is not part of their management approach.
